title: LLM-Driven Intake Intelligence Foundation
goal: Add optional LLM-assisted intake interpretation while preserving explicit scope and deterministic fallback behavior.
scope: Extend conversational intake with an optional provider-backed interpretation layer that can clarify ambiguous operator language, identify scope conflicts, suggest methodology or pack context, and propose safe follow-up questions. The schema must prevent scope broadening beyond explicit operator input, and deterministic intake must remain the fallback.
generation_reason: AI_PENTESTING_AGENT.md identifies intake intelligence as a missing capability beyond deterministic question routing.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: The LLM may clarify and suggest, but schema validation must block broader scope, access assumptions, unsafe targets, or unapproved packs.

success_criteria: Intake can optionally interpret ambiguous operator text into warnings, safe inferences, and follow-up questions.
The LLM layer cannot broaden target scope or access mode beyond explicit operator confirmation.
Provider-disabled and provider-failure paths preserve deterministic intake behavior.
Pack or methodology suggestions are advisory until operator confirmed.
Tests cover ambiguous input, scope conflict, disabled provider, provider failure, and no-scope-expansion rules.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: LLM intake is optional and fallback-safe.
Scope expansion is blocked by schema and tests.
Operator confirmation remains required for advisory suggestions.

before_promotion: Run attack narrative foundation is completed and logged.
Allowed intake inference and blocked scope-broadening behavior are documented.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with LLM intake changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with LLM intake boundaries and fallback behavior.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
